verdict.rationale: Vue's own SSR API documents Web Streams renderers (renderToWebStream, pipeToWebWritable) meant for edge environments such as Cloudflare Workers, so server-rendered Vue output can run on edge runtimes. The developer still has to write the request handler and deployment wiring; no first-party deployment adapters or presets are documented, and the Nuxt mention is a separate meta-framework. Missing for 10: zero-config deployment adapters or presets for serverless/edge platforms, documented end-to-end deployment guidance, independent hands-on corroboration of edge deployment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my server-rendered app to serverless or edge runtimes without custom infrastructure setup

citations.quote: // TransformStream is available in environments such as CloudFlare workers.
It is also possible to stream rendering using the Node.js Stream API or Web Streams API.
